title: QUIC ClientHello detection in NextLayer._get_client_hello and multi-datagram handling
answers: Why do QUIC flows to ignored hosts stall?
How does next_layer parse QUIC ClientHello for SNI?
What does quic_parse_client_hello_from_datagrams return for incomplete hello?
body:
- `next_layer.py:NextLayer._get_client_hello` for UDP calls `quic_parse_client_hello_from_datagrams([data_client])` (then falls back to `dtls_parse_client_hello`). Returns None if QUIC record incomplete, raises ValueError if not an Initial packet/invalid.
- `data_client` (`layer.py:NextLayer.data_client`) is the b"".join of all DataReceived events so far, so it is passed to the QUIC parser as ONE datagram, not a list of datagrams.
- Previously a None (incomplete) QUIC result was returned as 'no hello' so SNI was missing in `_ignore_connection`; the session changed it to raise NeedsMoreData (as TCP/DTLS do). Root cause of the reported stall was not confirmed and the fix is untested.
- Parser lives in `proxy/layers/quic/_client_hello_parser.py`.
applies: UDP/QUIC path in next_layer only; fix unverified
